definitions: To deal with only a very small part of a problem or subject.
To begin to investigate or deal with something, but only in a superficial way.
examples: We've only just started the project, so we're really just scratching the surface.
The initial report is good, but it's only scratching the surface of the issue.
There's so much more to learn; this lecture is just scratching the surface.
synonyms: just the tip of the iceberg
